name: Los Santos de la Humosa (Spain)
description: Red field with a yellow cross throughout, charged at the crossing with the crowned municipal arms of Los Santos de la Humosa (crossed palms on red above waves).
history: Los Santos de la Humosa adopted its arms and flag officially on 1 June 1991, published in the Boletín Oficial del Estado on 29 August 1991; the flag is of proportion 2/3, red with a yellow cross, charged over all at the centre with the municipal arms in its colours.

features.role: Los Santos de la Humosa arms — crossed palms on red above waves
